captions.detailed: A compact camera hot-shoe flash accessory. It consists of a main rectangular battery body in matte black, featuring a small rear screen with dual blue horizontal indicator bars and a physical command dial below it. The body is connected via a cylindrical swivel collar to a vertical neck, which supports a boxy rectangular flash lamp head with a white diffuser lens on its front face. The neck swivels horizontally above the body, the flash head tilts vertically, and the command dial is capable of continuous rotation.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated hot-shoe flash accessory for a camera. The design should feature a rectangular battery body with a hot-shoe mounting plate on the bottom, a rear screen with blue status lines, and a physical rotary command wheel. The body connects to a vertical neck that can swivel horizontally, and this neck supports a rectangular flash head with a front diffuser that can tilt vertically.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a box primitive with filleted vertical edges, adding a thin flat box for the hot-shoe plate at the bottom. Create the rear interface by recessing a screen area decorated with two small blue boxes for the display lines, and add a small cylinder for the command wheel. Model the neck using a cylinder for the base swivel joint and an upright rectangular prism, then mount a boxy flash head at the top with a thin white box on its front face representing the diffuser. Define three joint articulations: a vertical revolute joint for the neck swivel, a horizontal revolute joint for the head tilt, and a continuous rotation joint for the command wheel.
